title: WIRELESS TERMINAL, BASE STATION, AND METHOD
abstract: 【課題】ネットワークスライシングをサポートする通信システムのための無線端末及び気基地局を提供する.【解決手段】モバイル電気通信システム1において,ユーザ機器3は,サポートされているスライスのタイプに関連付けられる情報を含むシステム情報を受信する手段と,情報で示されるスライスについて,セル選択または初期アクセス手順を行う手段と,を備え,スライスのタイプは,オペレータ共通タイプ及びオペレータ特有タイプを含み,オペレータ共通タイプは,拡張モバイルブロードバンド(enhanced mobile broadband: eMBB),高信頼性及び低遅延用のクリティカル通信並びにもののインターネット(Internet of Things: IoT)用の大規模コミュニケーションを含む.【選択図】図1 To provide a wireless terminal and a base station for a communication system that supports network slicing.SOLUTION: In a mobile telecommunication system 1, a user equipment 3 includes means for receiving system information including information associated with supported slice types, and means for performing cell selection or initial access procedures for slices indicated in the information. The slice types include operator common types and operator specific types. The operator common types include enhanced mobile broadband (eMBB), critical communication for high reliability and low latency, and large-scale communication for Internet of Things (IoT).SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: UE(User Equipment),UE (USER EQUIPMENT)
abstract: 【課題】5GSにおいて,ネットワークスライスに関する情報の管理に関する機能又は非公共ネットワーク機能を実現するための通信手段を提供する. 【解決手段】5GSにおいて,ネットワークスライスに関する情報の管理又は非公共ネットワーク機能を実現するための,UEの初期の登録や,定期的又は移動に基づく登録の手続きの,方法及び通信手段を提供する.さらに,登録手続き完了後の及び非登録手続き,の方法及び通信手段を提供する.さらに,各手続き及び状態の遷移に伴うネットワークスライスに関する情報の管理方法を提供する. 【選択図】図6 To provide communication means for achieving, in 5GS, a function that pertains to management of information pertaining to network slicing or a non-public network function.SOLUTION: Provided are communication means and a method for procedures for UE initial registration and periodic or movement-based registration for achieving, in 5GS, management of information pertaining to network slicing or a non-public network function. Further provided are communication means and a method for a procedure after completion of a registration procedure and for a de-registration procedure. Further provided is a method for managing information pertaining to network slicing in association with each procedure and the transition of a state.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 6

title: METHOD FOR AUTHORIZING SERVICE REQUESTS IN COMMUNICATION NETWORK, AND COMMUNICATION NETWORK
abstract: 【課題】第5世代通信技術のネットワークスライシング保護するための通信ネットワークでサービス請求を認証する方法を提供する. 【解決手段】受信されたトークンがサービス認可管理モジュールによって有効であると検証されたことに応答してサービス請求に同意し,受信されたトークンがサービス認可管理モジュールによって無効であると検証されたことに応答してサービス請求を拒絶する. 【選択図】図2 To provide a method for authorizing service requests in a communication network for protecting a fifth generation communication technology's network slicing.SOLUTION: In the method, a service request is granted in response to a service authorization management module verifying that a received token is valid, and the service request is denied in response to the service authorization management module verifying that the received token is invalid.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title: DETERMINATION OF MACHINE LEARNING ARCHITECTURE FOR NETWORK SLICING
abstract: 【課題】ネットワークスライシングのための機械学習アーキテクチャを決定する方法および装置を提供する.【解決手段】ユーザ装置(UE)110およびネットワーク-スライスマネージャ190が,機械学習(ML)アーキテクチャを決定するために互いに通信する無線ネットワーク環境100であって,UE110は,アプリケーションが要求するサービス品質レベルを提供する機械学習アーキテクチャを選択する.ネットワーク-スライスマネージャ190は,アプリケーションが要求するサービス品質レベルをサポートするネットワークスライスに関連付けられた1つ以上の利用可能なエンドツーエンド機械学習アーキテクチャに基づいて,要求を受け付ける,または拒否する.【選択図】図1 To provide a method and a device that determine a machine learning architecture for network slicing.SOLUTION: In a wireless network environment 100 in which user equipment (UE) 110 and a network-slice manager 190 communicate with each other to determine a machine learning (ML) architecture, the UE 110 selects a machine learning architecture that provides the quality of service level required by an application. The network-slice manager 190 accepts or rejects requests on the basis of one or more available end-to-end machine learning architectures associated with network slices that support the quality of service level required by the application.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: COMMUNICATION DEVICE, CONTROL METHOD, AND PROGRAM
abstract: 【課題】IABを用いたネットワーク構成においてネットワークスライスを効率的に適用すること. 【解決手段】Integrated Access and Backhaul(IAB)の規定に従う中継伝送ネットワークにおけるIABドナーまたはそのIABドナーによって形成される通信経路に接続されるIABノードとして動作する通信装置は,その通信経路に接続されるIABノードに対してネットワークスライスを設定させるメッセージを送信する. 【選択図】 図1 To efficiently apply network slicing in a network configuration in the use of IAB.SOLUTION: A communication device operating as an IAB donor or an IAB node connected to a communication path formed by the IAB donor in a relay transmission network according to the provisions of Integrated Access and Backhaul (IAB) sends a message to set up a network slice to the IAB node connected to the communication path.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: TERMINAL DEVICE
abstract: 【課題】ネットワークスライシングで期待されるスペックで動作しているかをユーザに認識させることができる端末装置を提供する. 【解決手段】ネットワークスライシングに対応可能な端末装置であって,情報を出力可能な出力部と,基地局装置から,スライスの使用につき許可または拒絶を示す情報を受信可能な受信部と,前記受信した情報に基づいて,前記スライスの使用可能状況を前記出力部に出力させる制御部とを具備する. 【選択図】図1 To provide a terminal device that allows a user to recognize whether it is operating with the expected specifications for network slicing.SOLUTION: A terminal device capable of network slicing includes an output portion that can output information, a receiving unit capable of receiving information indicating permission or refusal for use of a slice from a base station device, and a control unit that outputs the usability status of the slice to the output portion on the basis of the received information.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: RADIO ACCESS NETWORK NODE AND METHOD
abstract: 【課題】通信装置が通信システムの一部を構成する通信システムを提供する.【解決手段】ネットワークスライスがサポートされ,少なくとも1つのテナントが該テナントに関連付けられた少なくとも1つのスライスタイプを使用して通信を行うことがきる移動体電気通信システム1であって,通信装置3-1~3-3は,基地局5-2からネットワークスライシング関連情報を受信する.ネットワークスライシング関連情報は,それの通信が基地局を介してサポートされるテナントに対するサポートを識別する情報及び特定のテナント又は特定のテナントのスライスタイプに関連付けられた少なくとも1つの通信パラメータを含む.通信装置は,ネットワークスライシング関連情報に基づいて,該通信装置が関連付けられたテナントのスライスタイプを有するスライスを使用する.【選択図】図1 To provide a communication system in which a communication device constitutes part of the communication system.SOLUTION: A mobile telecommunications system 1 supports a network slice and allows at least one tenant to communicate using at least one slice type associated with the tenant. Communication devices 3-1 to 3-3 receive network slicing-related information from a base station 5-2. The network slicing-related information includes information identifying support for tenants whose communication is supported via the base station and at least one communication parameter associated with a particular tenant or a slice type of the particular tenant. The communication device uses a slice having the slice type of the tenant with which the communication device is associated based on the network slicing-related information.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: UE PROVISION OF SLICE INFORMATION FOR IMPROVED NETWORK SLICE SELECTION DURING INTER RAT TRANSFERS
abstract: 【課題】RAT間転送中の動作を改善するために,ユーザ機器デバイス(UE)が,ネットワークスライス情報をセルラーネットワークに提供する装置,システム及び方法を提供する.【解決手段】無線通信システムにおいて,ユーザ機器デバイス(UE)は,ネットワークスライシングをサポートしない第1のセルラーネットワーク(4Gネットワーク)にスライス関連情報を提供する.このスライス関連情報は,ネットワークスライシングをサポートしている異なるセルラーネットワーク(5Gネットワーク)への後続のRAT間転送中に使用するために,適切なネットワークスライス選択支援情報(NSSAI)をUEに提供する際に4Gネットワークを支援することができる.【選択図】図9 To provide a device, a system, and a method for a user equipment device (UE) to provide network slice information to a cellular network in order to improve operation during inter RAT transfers.SOLUTION: In a wireless communication system, a user equipment device (UE) provides slice related information to a first cellular network (4G Network) that does not support network slicing. This slice related information may assist the 4G Network in providing the appropriate network slice selection assistance information (NSSAI) to the UE for use during subsequent inter RAT transfers to a different cellular network (5G Network) that does support network slicing.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 9

title: WIRELESS COMMUNICATION METHOD AND SYSTEM FOR NETWORK SLICING
abstract: 【課題】ユーザ機器(UE)が,多くの配備シナリオを含むLTE-NRインターワーキングで構成される場合,UEを,UEの所望のネットワークスライス/サービスをサポートすることができる適切な/相応しいRATに確実に接続する無線通信方法,ユーザ機器及びシステムを提供する. 【解決手段】無線通信システム200において,UE201は,ネットワークスライス要求260を基地局203に送信する.ネットワークスライス要求は,UE201のID及び支援情報を含む.基地局203は,ネットワークスライス要求の支援情報に応答してネットワークスライス応答を生成する.UE201は,基地局からネットワークスライス応答262を受信する.ネットワークスライス応答は,ネットワークスライス要求がサポートされているかどうかを示す. 【選択図】図2 To provide a wireless communication method, user equipment (UE) and system that ensure that the UE connects to an appropriate/suitable RAT, which can support the UE's desired network slice/service when the UE is configured with LTE-NR interworking, which includes many deployment scenarios.SOLUTION: In a wireless communication system 200, UE 201 sends a network slice request 260 to a base station 203. The network slice request includes an ID of the UE 201 and assistance information. The base station 203 generates a network slice response 262 in response to the assistance information in the network slice request. The UE 201 receives the network slice response from the base station. The network slice response indicates whether the network slice request is supported.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title: MANAGEMENT SERVER, NETWORK SYSTEM, ROUTER MANAGEMENT METHOD, AND PROGRAM
abstract: 【課題】ネットワークスライシングの利用を想定した構成において,ネットワークスライスに対応してルータの記憶領域に記憶される経路情報を適切に管理,更新する. 【解決手段】それぞれが1つ以上の仮想的ネットワークに属する1つ以上のルータを管理する管理サーバであって,ルータが仮想的ネットワークを介して接続された別のルータから受信した経路情報を用いて当該ルータの記憶領域に記憶されている経路情報を更新する場合に,当該ルータの記憶領域に記憶されている仮想的ネットワークごとの経路情報が示す経路数が,仮想的ネットワークごとに設定される所定の閾値を超えるか否かを,前記管理サーバにおいて管理しているルータ情報に基づいて判定する判定手段と,前記判定手段により前記経路数が前記所定の閾値を超えると判定された場合,前記ルータに対し経路情報の更新の制限を指示する指示手段とを備えることを特徴とする. 【選択図】図5 To appropriately manage and update route information stored in a storage area of a router in response to a network slice, in a configuration that assumes the use of network slicing.SOLUTION: A management server for managing one or more routers, each belonging to one or more virtual networks, includes: determination means for determining whether or not the number of routes indicated by the route information for each virtual network stored in a storage area of the router exceeds a predetermined threshold set for each virtual network on the basis of the router information managed in the management server, when the route information stored in the storage area of the router is updated using the route information that the router receives from another router connected via the virtual network; and instruction means for instructing the restriction of updating the route information to the router, when the determination means determines that the number of routes exceeds a predetermined threshold.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 5

title: CONTROL DEVICE, CONTROL METHOD, AND PROGRAM
abstract: 【課題】ネットワークスライシングが適用されたRANにおいて,基地局機能の配置に応じて,RAN内での分散的な学習のための計算機リソースの使用を適応的に制御する. 【解決手段】学習コントローラ20は,RANにおける基地局の機能の配置を示す配置情報として,RAN上に設定されたスライスごとの,DU及びCUの配置を示す配置情報を取得する.学習コントローラ20は,取得された配置情報と,RANにおける処理に使用される,学習対象の学習モデルとに基づいて,1つ以上のアンテナサイト及び収容局に対する,学習モデルの学習をRAN内で分散して行うための学習ユニットの配置を制御する.RAN内で配置される学習ユニットは,配置先において使用可能な計算機リソースを用いて,学習モデルに対応した取得先から学習データを取得して学習を行う. 【選択図】図4 To adaptively control the use of a computer resource for distributed learning within a RAN to which network slicing is applied according to the placement of a base station function in the RAN.SOLUTION: A learning controller 20 acquires arrangement information indicating the arrangement of a DU and a CU for each slice set on the RAN as arrangement information indicating the arrangement of base station functions in the RAN. The learning controller 20 controls the arrangement of the learning unit to distribute the learning of the learning model to one or more antenna sites and accommodating stations within the RAN on the basis of the acquired arrangement information and the learning model to be learned used for processing in the RAN. The learning unit arranged in the RAN uses computer resources available at the arrangement destination to acquire learning data from the acquisition destination corresponding to the learning model and perform learning.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title: VIRTUAL RADIO ACCESS NETWORK SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR OPTIMIZED REAL-TIME RESPONSIVE CONTINUOUS LOCATION INFORMATION-BASED CLOUD COMPUTING, RENDERING, TRACKING, AND COMMUNICATION SERVICES IN THREE-DIMENSIONAL SPACE THROUGH DISTRIBUTED COMPUTING CENTER NETWORK
abstract: 【課題】分散型計算センタネットワークによるクラウドコンピューティング,レンダリング,追跡及び通信を含む,3次元空間リアルタイム位置情報に基づくサービスを可能にするシステム及び方法を提供する. 【解決手段】広域分散型計算センタネットワークシステム100は,データセンタに接続された分散型計算センタを含む.各計算センタは,1つ以上のクライアント装置のために計算及びレンダリングを行うのに十分な計算リソースを有する1つ以上のクラウドサーバを備える.各データセンタは,アプリケーション及びユーザデータの記憶,クラウドサーバによって送信されたデジタルリアリティデータの同期並びに動的ネットワークスライシング及びサービス品質管理を行うのに十分な計算リソースを有する1つ以上のマスタサーバを備える.これらの方法を行うための命令は,クラウドサーバ内のデジタルリアリティ仮想無線アクセスネットワーク部に実装されている. 【選択図】図1 To provide systems and methods for enabling real-time location information-based services in three-dimensional space, including cloud computing, rendering, tracking, and communication through a distributed computing center network.SOLUTION: A wide area distributed computing center network system 100 includes distributed computing centers connected to data centers. Each computing center comprises one or more cloud servers with computing resources sufficient to perform computing and rendering for one or more client devices. Each data center comprises one or more master servers with computing resources sufficient to perform application and user data storage, synchronization of digital reality data sent by cloud servers, and dynamic network slicing and quality of service management. Instructions to perform these methods are implemented in a digital reality virtual radio access network portion in cloud servers.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: RESOURCE MANAGEMENT APPARATUS, RESOURCE MANAGEMENT SYSTEM, RESOURCE MANAGEMENT METHOD, AND PROGRAM
abstract: 【課題】アプリケーションのマイクロサービス化およびネットワークスライシングに対応できるリソース管理装置,リソース管理システム,リソース管理方法,およびプログラムを提供する. 【解決手段】仮想通信機器のリソースを管理するリソース管理装置100であって,目的とするネットワーク毎にネットワーク構築に必要な通信機器およびそのSLAを管理し,ネットワーク構築指示をするネットワーク構築部110と,前記ネットワーク構築指示に基づいて,前記通信機器に対応する仮想通信機器の機能,前記機能が使用するハードウェアリソース,および性能値を確認し,前記仮想通信機器の構成を決定する通信機器構成部120と,前記決定された仮想通信機器の構成に基づいてハードウェアリソースを割り当てる機能構築部130と,前記ハードウェアリソースの使用状況を監視するリソース監視部140と,を備える. 【選択図】図2 To provide a resource management apparatus, a resource management system, a resource management method, and a program that address the deployment of microservices and network slicing for applications.SOLUTION: A resource management apparatus 100 that manages resources of virtual communication equipment comprises: a networking unit 110 that manages communication equipment required for networking and SLA thereof on a per target network basis and issues a networking instruction; a communication equipment configuration unit 120 that identifies, according to the networking instruction, a function of virtual communication equipment corresponding to the communication equipment, hardware resources used by the function, and a performance value to determine the configuration of the virtual communication equipment; a function building unit 130 that allocates hardware resources according to the determined configuration of the virtual communication equipment; and a resource monitoring unit 140 that monitors the usage of the hardware resources.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title: CONTROL APPARATUS, CONTROL METHOD, AND PROGRAM
abstract: 【課題】ネットワークスライシングが適用された基地局システムにおいて,スライス間のアイソレーションを確保しながら,各スライスが提供するサービス品質を高めるように,各スライスに無線リソースの配分を行う. 【解決手段】RANコントローラ40は,予め定められた配分率に従って,複数のスライスのそれぞれに対して無線リソースの仮割り当て量を決定する.RANコントローラ40は,スライスごとに,当該スライスについて求まる予測通信容量が,当該スライスに対して定められた目標値を満たすまで,仮割り当て量を上限として無線リソースを当該スライスに割り当てる.更に,RANコントローラ40は,目標値が満たされることなく,割り当てられた無線リソースの量が上限に達した1つ以上のスライスに対して,目標値が満たされたスライスに対して割り当てられなかった余剰の無線リソースを配分する. 【選択図】図3 To allocate radio resources to slices in a base station system where network slicing is applied so as to enhance the quality of service provided by each slice while ensuring isolation between the slices.SOLUTION: A RAN controller 40 determines a temporary amount of allocation of radio resources to each of a plurality of slices according to a predetermined allocation ratio. The RAN controller 40 allocates radio resources to each slice not more than its temporary amount of allocation until the expected communication capacity calculated for the slice meets a determined target value for the slice. Further the RAN controller 40 allocates the excess radio resources not allocated to slices that have already met the respective target values to one or more slices to which radio resource allocation reached the limit without meeting the respective target values.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title: COMMUNICATION METHOD, CONTROL PLANE DEVICE, METHOD FOR CONTROL PLANE DEVICE OR COMMUNICATION TERMINAL, AND COMMUNICATION TERMINAL
abstract: 【課題】ネットワークスライシングがコアネットワークに適用された場合に,分割されたそれぞれのネットワークにおいて高いセキュリティレベルを維持することができる通信システムを提供することを目的とする. 【解決手段】本開示にかかる通信システムは,通信端末の加入者情報を管理する加入者情報管理装置(10)と,通信端末の識別情報と,通信端末が利用可能な少なくとも1つのネットワークスライスシステムにおいて用いられるセキュリティ情報とを関連付けて管理するセキュリティ装置(20)と,を備える.加入者情報管理装置(10)は,通信端末の識別情報及び通信端末が利用するネットワークスライスシステムの識別情報を用いてセキュリティ装置(20)から通信端末が利用するネットワークスライスシステムにおいて用いられるセキュリティ情報を取得する. 【選択図】図1 To provide a communication system capable of maintaining a higher security level at each of divided core networks to which network slicing is applied.SOLUTION: A communication system according to the present disclosure comprises: a subscriber information management device (10) to manage subscriber information of a communication terminal ; and a security device (20) to manage identification information of the communication terminal and security information used at at least one network slice system available for the communication terminal, associating the identification information with the security information. The subscriber information management device (10) uses the identification information of the communication terminal and identification information of a network slice system that the communication terminal uses to acquire from the security device (20) security information used at the network slice system that the communication uses.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: NETWORK MONITORING DEVICE, TRANSMISSION DEVICE, AND NETWORK MONITORING METHOD
abstract: 【課題】ネットワークスライシングが適用される通信システムで,ネットワーク管理の負荷を低減する. 【解決手段】ネットワーク監視装置は,データフローのスライス/サービスタイプと優先度情報に基づいて,前記データフローが属するグループを特定し,同じグループに含まれる複数のデータフローに同じネットワークスライスを割り当てるグルーピング制御部と, 前記グルーピング制御部で生成されたグルーピング制御情報に基づいて,前記ネットワークスライスのエッジノードを制御するスライスコントローラと,を有する. 【選択図】図3 To reduce the load of network management in a communication network in which network slicing is applied.SOLUTION: A network monitoring device includes: a grouping control unit that identifies a group to which a data flow belongs on the basis of the slice/service type and priority information of the data flow and allocates the same network slice to a plurality of data flows included in the same group; and a slice controller that controls an edge node of the network slice on the basis of grouping control information generated by the grouping control unit.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title: CONNECTING TO VIRTUALIZED MOBILE CORE NETWORKS
abstract: 【課題】5Gネットワークアーキテクチャにおいて,仮想化およびネットワークスライシングを使用する. 【解決手段】ユーザ機器UEは,仮想ネットワークスライスと相互作用するアンダーレイネットワークと相互作用する.UEは,アンダーレイネットワーク(ULN)と相互作用し,仮想ネットワークスライスへの接続を確立する.プロシージャが,新しいスライスインスタンスをUEに割り当てるために(UE開始型およびULN開始型),UEプロファイルを変更するために(UE開始型およびULN開始型),かつUEの割り当てられたスライスインスタンスを変更するために(ULN開始型)定義される. 【選択図】図24 To provide a 5G network architecture that uses virtualization and network slicing.SOLUTION: User equipment (UE) interacts with an underlay network that interacts with virtual network slices. The UE interacts with the underlay network (ULN) to establish a connection to a virtual network slice. Procedures are defined to: assign a new slice instance to the UE (UE-initiated and ULN-initiated); change a UE profile (UE-initiated and ULN-initiated); and change the slice instance assigned to the UE (ULN-initiated).SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 24

title: NETWORK SLICING OPERATION
abstract: 【課題】ネットワークスライスに接続する方法を提供する. 【解決手段】ネットワーク制御ノードは,WTRUによるサービス要求(サービスクラス,サービス品質要件,またはモビリティ特性のうちの1つまたは複数を備える)を受信することができ,複数のネットワークスライスに関連付けられたスライス情報を決定することができ,WTRUにサーブために少なくとも第1のネットワークスライスを選択することができ,第1のネットワークスライスにアクセスするためにネットワーク制御ノードまたは別のネットワーク制御ノードがWTRUにサーブすべきであるかどうかを決定することができ,第1のネットワークスライスにアクセスするために別のネットワーク制御ノードがWTRUにサーブすべきであると決定する場合,別のネットワーク制御ノードがWTRUにサーブすべきであることを示す要求を別のネットワーク制御ノードに送信することができる. 【選択図】図5 To provide a method for connecting to a network slice.SOLUTION: A network control node may: receive a service request (including one or more of a service class, service quality requirements or mobility characteristics) by a WTRU(wireless transmission/reception unit); determine slice information associated with a plurality of network slices; select at least a first network slice for serving the WTRU; determine whether or not the network control node or another network control node should serve the WTRU for performing access to the first network slice; and, when determining that the another network control node should serve the WTRU for performing access to the first network slice, transmit a request indicating that the another network control node should serve the WTRU to the another network control node.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 5

title: BASE STATION SYSTEM AND WIRELESS COMMUNICATION DEVICE
abstract: 【課題】ネットワークスライシングが適用された基地局システムにおいて,異なる場所に配置された複数のスケジューラからのスケジューリング情報に基づく各スライスへの無線リソースの割り当てのタイミングを制御する. 【解決手段】WRH120は,アンテナサイトに配置され,それぞれ異なるDU20に含まれる複数のスケジューラ21に対して,RANコントローラ40から通知された配分率に従って,対応するスライスで使用される無線リソースのリソースブロックを割り当てる.WRH120は,各スケジューラ21からスケジューリング情報を受信した後,当該スケジューリング情報を,所定の時間間隔ごとに到来する転送タイミングに,RU30へ転送する. 【選択図】図4 To control radio resource allocation timing to each slice based on scheduling information from a plurality of schedulers disposed at different places in a base station system to which network slicing is applied.SOLUTION: A WRH 120 is disposed at an antenna site and allocates a resource block of a radio resource used in a corresponding slice according to a distribution rate notified from a RAN controller 40 to a plurality of schedulers 21 included in respective different DUs 20. The WRH 120 transmits scheduling information to an RU 30 at transfer timing arriving at every predetermined time interval after receiving the scheduling information from each scheduler 21.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title: BASE STATION SYSTEM, WIRELESS UNIT, AND WIRELESS COMMUNICATION DEVICE
abstract: 【課題】ネットワークスライシングが適用された基地局システムにおいて,単一の無線ユニットを用いて複数のスライス(サービス)を提供可能にする. 【解決手段】複数のDU20は,基地局の機能のうちの無線リソースのスケジューリング機能を少なくとも有し,それぞれが1つ以上のスライスに対応している.複数のCU10は,それぞれが,複数のDU20のうちの異なる1つのDUとコアネットワークとの間に接続され,基地局の機能のうち,当該1つのDUが有する機能よりも上位レイヤの機能を有する.RU30は,基地局の機能のうちの電波の送受信機能を少なくとも有し,アンテナサイトに配置される.RU30は,複数のDU20と接続され,当該複数のDU20を介して提供される複数のスライスが,RU30によって形成される同一のセル内で提供される. 【選択図】図4 To allow a plurality of slices (services) to be provided using a single wireless unit in a base station system to which network slicing is applied.SOLUTION: A plurality of DUs 20 at least have a scheduling function of radio resources among functions of a base station, and each DU corresponds to one or more slices. Each of a plurality of CUs 10 is connected between different one DU among the plurality of DUs 20 and a core network and has an upper layer function than a function held by the one DU among the functions of the base station. An RU 30 at least has a transmission/reception function of a radio wave among the functions of the base station and is disposed at an antenna site. The RU 30 is connected to the plurality of DUs 20, and a plurality of slices provided via the plurality of DUs 20 are provided in the same cell formed by the RU 30.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title: COMMUNICATION SYSTEM SUPPORTING NETWORK SLICING
abstract: 【課題】実用的なスライシングメカニズムの提供に貢献する装置及び関連する方法を提供する. 【解決手段】ネットワークスライスがサポートされ,テナントが関連付けられたスライスタイプを使用して通信を行うことがきる移動体用電気通信システム1において,基地局5-1,5-2は,ネットワークスライシング関連情報を生成する.ネットワークスライシング関連情報は,それの通信が基地局を介してサポートされているテナント及び基地局によってサポートされているテナントのネットワークスライスタイプに対するサポートを識別する情報,特定のテナント及び特定のテナントの特定のスライスタイプに関連付けられた通信パラメータを含む情報,のうちの少なくとも1つを含む.基地局は,ネットワークスライシング関連情報を他の基地局及び通信装置のうちの少なくとも1つに送信する. 【選択図】図1 To provide an apparatus and an associated method that contribute to provision of a practical working slicing mechanism.SOLUTION: There is provided a mobile telecommunication system 1 in which network slicing is supported and in which a tenant is able to communicate using a slice type associated with the tenant. Base stations 5-1, 5-2 generate network slicing related information. The network slicing related information comprises at least one of: information identifying support for a tenant whose communication is supported via a base station and a network slice type of a tenant that is supported by a base station; and information comprising a communication parameter that is associated with a specific tenant and a specific slice type of a specific tenant. The base station transmits the network slicing related information to at least one of another base station and a communication device.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: MANAGEMENT SERVER, NETWORK SYSTEM, ROUTER MANAGEMENT METHOD, AND PROGRAM
abstract: 【課題】ネットワークスライシングの利用を想定した構成において,ネットワークスライスに対応してルータの記憶領域に記憶される経路情報を適切に管理,更新する. 【解決手段】ネットワークスライスに適合される1または複数のルータを管理する管理サーバであって,前記1または複数のルータそれぞれに対し,各ルータの記憶領域における,ネットワークスライスごとの経路情報を記憶したメモリ使用状態を管理するための情報である管理情報を記憶する記憶手段と,ルータがネットワークスライスを介して接続された別のルータから受信した経路情報を用いて当該ルータの記憶領域に記憶されている経路情報を更新する場合に,当該ルータの記憶領域におけるメモリ使用状態が所定の閾値を超えるか否かを前記管理情報に基づいて判定する判定手段と,前記所定の閾値を超えると判定された場合,前記ルータに対し経路情報の更新の制限を指示する指示手段とを備える. 【選択図】図5 To appropriately manage and update route information stored in a storage area of a router in correspondence with a network slice, in a configuration assuming use of network slicing.SOLUTION: A management server for managing one or a plurality of routers adapted to a network slice includes: storage means for storing management information for managing a memory usage state storing path information for each network slice in a storage area of each router, to each of the one or a plurality of routers; determination means for determining whether or not the memory usage state in the storage area of the router exceeds a predetermined threshold on the basis of the management information, when the router updates the path information stored in the storage area of the router using the path information received from another router connected via the network slice; and instruction means for instructing the limit of updating the path information to the router, when it is determined that the memory usage state exceeds the predetermined threshold.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 5

title: METHOD FOR DETECTING INTERFERENCE IN INTEGRATION OF REVISED NETWORK, ITS SYSTEM AND RECORDING MEDIUM RECORDING INTERFERENCE DETECTION PROGRAM
abstract: 【課題】 従来管理者が行っていたネットワーク変更に伴う干渉に関する検査をネットワーク上に存在するサービス間の関連に基づき形式的に行い,干渉の有無を自動判定し,干渉箇所を自動検出する変更ネットワークの統合における干渉検出方法および装置と干渉検出プログラムを記録した記録媒体を提供する. 【解決手段】 変更影響節点特定部5がサービス間の依存関係を形式的に表現したネットワーク依存グラフにおいて変更の影響を受けるサービスと影響を受けないサービスを部分グラフとして切り分け,変更統合部7で変更サービス群と無変更サービス群の統合をグラフの合成により行い,更にネットワーク.スライシング技術を用いて,変更影響節点特定部5と干渉検査部9においてネットワーク依存グラフ上の変更サービス群だけを部分グラフとして正確に抽出できる. PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide the interference detection method resulting from integrating a revised network that is terms of illustration checks interference attended with network revision having conventionally been conducted by a manager based on relation between services in existence on the network, decides automatically the presence of interference, and automatically detects an interfered point, to provide its system and the recording medium that records an interference detection program. SOLUTION: A revision effect node specification section 5 segments services receiving effect of revision and services not receiving effect of revision on a network dependent graph that expresses in terms of illustration the dependence among services as sub-graphs, a revision integration section 7 integrates a revised service group and a non-revision service group by means of graph synthesis, and the revision effect node specification section 5 and an interference check section 9 accurately extract only the revision service group on the network dependence graph as the sub-graphs by using the network slicing technology.

abstract: Abstract not available for JP7597902B2 Abstract of corresponding document: US2024373337A1 This document describes techniques and devices for determining a machine-learning architecture for network slicing. A user equipment (UE) executes a first application associated with a first requested quality-of-service level. The UE selects a first machine-learning architecture based on the first requested quality-of-service level. The UE transmits, to a network-slice manager of a wireless network, a first machine-learning architecture request message to request permission to use the first machine-learning architecture. The UE receives, from the network-slice manager, a first machine-learning architecture response message that grants permission to use the first machine-learning architecture based on a first network slice. The UE wirelessly communicates data for the first application using the first machine-learning architecture, the first machine-learning architecture being configured to compute an output based on an input using coefficients determined by the user equipment.

abstract: Abstract not available for JP7499793B2 Abstract of corresponding document: US2022369215A1 A cellular communication system supports network slicing and has a network relay function (140) for managing the indirect connections. A mobile device (110) may send a request message to a relay device (120), the request message including a slice to access. A response message indicates available slice(s) and relay device(s). abstract: Abstract not available for JP6902517B2 Abstract of corresponding document: JP2021141622A To appropriately manage and update route information stored in a storage area of a router in response to a network slice, in a configuration that assumes the use of network slicing.SOLUTION: A management server for managing one or more routers, each belonging to one or more virtual networks, includes: determination means for determining whether or not the number of routes indicated by the route information for each virtual network stored in a storage area of the router exceeds a predetermined threshold set for each virtual network on the basis of the router information managed in the management server, when the route information stored in the storage area of the router is updated using the route information that the router receives from another router connected via the virtual network; and instruction means for instructing the restriction of updating the route information to the router, when the determination means determines that the number of routes exceeds a predetermined threshold.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 5

title: アクセス禁止方法,装置及び通信システム
abstract: Abstract not available for JP6798623B2 Abstract of corresponding document: US11546834B2 An access barring method and apparatus and a communication system. The method includes: performing access barring check or access class determination by UE by using parameters defined for a new radio system. The parameters are applicable to all radio resource control (RRC) states. For different public land mobile networks (PLMNs) and/or network slicing, the parameters are identical or different. With the embodiments of this disclosure, selectable parameters are provided for a uniform access control mechanism defined by an NR system, thereby simplifying an access mechanism, and ensuring all-directional compatibility of a terminal state.

title: ネットワークスライス発見および選択
abstract: Abstract not available for JP6692936B2 Abstract of corresponding document: US2017367036A1 An NR network slicing architecture may be used to facilitate network slice discovery and selection. Mechanisms to discover and select network slices may differ depending on whether a user equipment is in an idle mode or a connected mode. Further, in various examples, the network slice discovery and selection may be performed by a UE, a radio access network (RAN), or a core network (CN), based on a variety of selection criteria.
company_name: コンヴィーダ  ワイヤレス,  エルエルシー
assignees: コンヴィーダ  ワイヤレス,  エルエルシー

title: ネットワークスライシングをサポートする通信システム
abstract: Abstract not available for JP6669305B2 Abstract of corresponding document: EP4554286A2 A communication system is disclosed in which a communication device forms part of a communication system in which network slicing is supported and in which at least one tenant is able to communicate using at least one slice type associated with that tenant. The communication device receives network slicing related information transmitted by a base station. The network slicing related information may comprise information identifying support for a tenant whose communication is supported via the base station, or a network slice type of a tenant that is supported by the base station. The network slicing related information may comprise information comprising at least one communication parameter that is associated with a specific tenant or a specific slice type of a specific tenant. The communication device uses a slice having a slice type of a tenant with which the communication device is associated, based on the network slicing related information.

title: SYSTEM OF RESOURCE RELATIONSHIPS AND FAULT LOCALIZATION, METHOD AND COMPUTER READABLE MEDIUM THEREOF
abstract: 本發明揭露一種資源關聯與障礙定位系統及其方法，目的是提供全域虛擬實體資源的跨層關聯，並藉此簡化核網子網路切片障礙點查測作業，本發明透過從網路功能虛擬化管理與編排平台取得已實例化之網路服務的竣後詳情，以及取得基礎設施系統之系統局情資料，重組與關聯底層基礎設施資源和核網子網路切片之網路服務(NS)與基於虛擬機或容器虛擬網路功能(VNF)間關係，達成子網路切片網元資源之關聯拓樸以及即時障礙定位。本發明復提供一種電腦可讀媒介，係用於執行本發明之方法。 The present invention is a system of resource relationships and fault localization and a method thereof. The purpose of the present invention is to provide a cross-layer association of global virtual entity resources and thereby simplify fault point detection operation for core network slice subnet. In the present invention, completed details of the instantiated network services from Network Functions Virtualisation Management and Orchestration(NFV MANO) platform and system situation information of the infrastructure system are obtained and used for reorganize and associate the underlying infrastructure resources and the relationship between the Network Services(NS) of the core network subnet slice and Virtualised Network Function(VNF) based on virtual machines or containers, so as to get the associated topology of the network slice subnet element resources and instant fault localization. The present invention also provides a computer-readable medium for executing the method of the present invention.

title: EMERGENCY AMBULANCE INFORMATION TRANSMISSION SYSTEM, METHOD AND COMPUTER READABLE MEDIUM THEREOF
abstract: 本發明係一種緊急救護資訊傳送系統及其方法，係接收來自用戶終端且包含該用戶終端之身分別的訊息封包，並解析該訊息封包以搜尋出對應該訊息封包的來源身分，俾於該來源身分屬於緊急救護身分者，提供預先設定且對應該來源身分之專屬5G網路切片，使得該訊息封包經由該專屬5G網路切片進行傳遞，另外，本發明復將來自各救護單位所提供之救護能量進行分析，評估來自該用戶終端之救護需求及該救護能量後，給予該用戶終端運送之救護指示。本發明復提供一種電腦可讀媒介，係用於執行本發明之方法。 The present invention is an emergency ambulance information transmission system and a method thereof. When a message packet from a user terminal and included the identity of the user terminal be received. The message packet can be parsed to search the source identity corresponding to the message packet. If the source identity of the message packet belongs to the emergency rescue identity, a preset exclusive 5G network slice corresponding to the source identity is provided, so that the message packet can be delivered through the exclusive 5G network slice. In addition, the rescue energy provided by each rescue unit can be analyzed, and a rescue demand from the user terminal and the rescue energy can be evaluated, so as to deliver a rescue instruction to the user terminal for emergency ambulance. The present invention also provides a computer-readable medium for executing the method of the present invention.

title: DISABLING N1 MODE UPON RECEIVING A 5GMM CAUSE VALUE MESSAGE
abstract: 一種方法包括由一使用者裝備(UE)根據一非取用層(NAS)協定將一登記請求訊息傳輸至一網路節點，該登記請求訊息包括對一第一網路中之一或多個單網路切片選擇輔助資訊(S-NSSAI)的一請求。該UE自該網路節點接收一登記拒絕訊息，該登記拒絕訊息包括一5G系統移動性管理(5GMM)原因值#62「無網路切片可用」指示。該UE基於該接收該登記拒絕訊息而對該第一網路停用N1模式能力，儲存該第一網路之一識別碼，且在儲存之後，在一網路選擇過程期間由該UE利用該第一網路之所儲存識別碼。 A method includes transmitting, by a user equipment (UE), a registration request message to a network node according to a non-access stratum (NAS) protocol, the registration request message including a request for one or more single-network slice selection assistance informations (S-NSSAIs) in a first network. The UE receives a registration reject message from the network node, the registration reject message including a 5G system mobility management (5GMM) cause value #62 “no network slices available” indication. The UE disables N1 mode capability for the first network based upon the receiving the registration reject message, stores an identity of the first network, and, after storing, exploits the stored identity of the first network, by the UE, during a network selection process.

title: DISABLING N1 MODE UPON RECEIVING A 5GMM CAUSE VALUE MESSAGE
abstract: 一種方法包括由一使用者裝備(UE)將一第一訊息傳輸至一網路節點，該第一訊息包括用於根據一非取用層(NAS)協定取用一第一網路的一請求。該UE自該網路節點接收一第二訊息，該第二訊息包括指出無網路切片可用於服務該UE所請求之對該第一網路之取用的一指示。該UE基於對該第二訊息的接收而停用使用該NAS協定來取用網路的能力，儲存該第一網路之一識別碼，並在儲存之後，由該UE在一網路選擇過程期間利用所儲存之該第一網路之該識別碼。 A method includes transmitting, by a user equipment (UE), a first message to a network node, the first message including a request for access to a first network according to a non-access stratum (NAS) protocol. The UE receives a second message from the network node, the second message including an indication of no network slice being available to service access to the first network requested by the UE. The UE disables a capability to access networks using the NAS protocol based upon the receiving the second message, stores an identity of the first network, and after storing, exploits the stored identity of the first network, by the UE, during a network selection process.

title: NETWORK SLICE FEASIBILITY ASSESSMENT FOR SLICE ORCHESTRATION IN A WIRELESS NETWORK
abstract: 本揭露提供用於無線網路中的切片編排的網路切片可行性評定的系統、方法及設備，其包括編碼於電腦儲存媒體上的電腦程式。一些態樣係關於在與服務管理相關聯的裝置處提供對所請求的網路切片的按需核准或拒絕。該裝置可選擇針對無線網路中的單元集中的各單元的所請求的網路切片的各別資源分配，將各別預測資源分配添加至該等單元之各者處的各別目前資源利用率，且根據總和來輸出與所請求的網路切片相關聯的推薦。該裝置可根據該所請求的網路切片的服務等級協議(SLA)及在一些實施方案中根據在無線網路中的該等單元之各者處的經觀察網路條件來選擇所請求的網路切片的各別資源分配。 This disclosure provides systems, methods and apparatus, including computer programs encoded on computer storage media, for network slice feasibility assessment for slice orchestration in a wireless network. Some aspects relate to providing on-demand approval or rejection of a requested network slice at a device associated with service management. The device may select respective resource allocations of the requested network slice for each cell of a set of cells in a wireless network, add the respective predicted resource allocations to respective current resource utilizations at each of the cells, and output a recommendation associated with the requested network slice in accordance with the summations. The device may select the respective resource allocations of the requested network slice in accordance with a service level agreement (SLA) of the requested network slice and, in some implementations, observed network conditions at each of the cells in the wireless network.

title: METHODS AND APPARATUS FOR WTRU MEMBER SELECTION USING NETWORK SLICE AVAILABILITY ANALYTICS
abstract: 一網路節點從一應用功能接收一請求，該請求用於聯合學習操作的無線傳輸/接收單元(WTRU)選擇協助。此請求包括候選WTRU的一第一清單的一指示、至少一篩選標準的一指示、以及各WTRU的一貢獻權重的一指示。該貢獻權重的該指示基於一服務經驗類型、一時間或一位置，而指示該等WTRU之各者的一服務經驗的一最小相對重要性。該網路節點向該應用功能發送一通知 ，其中，該通知包括該等候選WTRU之一子集的一第二清單之一指示。第二清單中指示的WTRU各具有基於貢獻權重所加權而滿足至少一篩選標準的一服務經驗度量。 A network node receives, from an application function, a request for wireless transmit/receive unit (WTRU) selection assistance for federated learning operations. The request includes an indication of a first list of candidate WTRUs, an indication of at least one filtering criteria, and an indication of a contribution weight for each WTRU. The indication of the contribution weight indicates a minimum relative importance of a service experience of each of the WTRUs based on a service experience type, a time or a location. The network node sends, to the application function ,a notification, wherein the notification includes an indication of a second list of a subset of the candidate WTRUs. The WTRUs indicated in the second list each have a service experience metric, weighted based on the contribution weight, that meets the at least one filtering criteria.

title: CONTAINER NETWORK COMMUNICATION SYSTEM AND METHOD
abstract: 一種容器網路通訊方法包含以下步驟。將目的網路位址為第二容器之第一封包經由第一軟體定義網路交換機之第一隧道端口進行隧道協定封裝以得出第一隧道封包；透過第一軟體定義網路交換機將第一隧道封包送至第二軟體定義網路交換機，再於第二軟體定義網路交換機之第二隧道端口進行隧道協定解封裝，使第二容器取得第一封包的資料。 A container network communication method includes steps as follows. The first packet whose destination network address is the second container is packed through a first tunnel endpoint of the first SDN switch by using a tunneling protocol to obtain a first tunnel packet; the first SDN switch sends the first tunnel packet to the second SDN switch, and then a second tunnel endpoint of the second SDN switch unpacks the first tunnel packet by using the tunneling protocol, so that the second container obtains the data of the first packet.
company_name: NATIONAL YANG MING CHIAO TUNG UNIVERSITY
assignees: NATIONAL YANG MING CHIAO TUNG UNIVERSITY

title: SEPARATING END-TO-END TRUST DOMAINS WITH CELLULAR TECHNOLOGY
abstract: 本發明提供一種通信裝置，其可經由一通信網路之一第一網路切片自一第一外部應用伺服器接收(510)資訊。該通信裝置可進一步基於該資訊經由該通信網路之一第二網路切片與一第二外部應用伺服器通信(520)。 A communication device can receive (510) information from a first external application server via a first network slice of a communications network. The communication device can further communicate (520) with a second external application server via a second network slice of the communications network based on the information.

title: SDN-BASED MECHANISM FOR VIRTUAL MACHINE LIVE MIGRATION SYSTEM AND METHOD
abstract: 一種基於軟體定義網路之虛擬機動態搬遷系統及其方法，該方法包括VIM控制器接收動態搬遷請求指令，依據動態搬遷請求指令從第一、第二Hypervisor中獲取相同網域第一虛擬機、相同網域第二虛擬機、來源端虛擬機以及目標端虛擬機的虛擬機網路資源使用資訊並傳送至SDN控制器，SDN控制器控制第一SDN vSwitch、第二SDN vSwitch以及至少一實體交換器將相同網域第一虛擬機、相同網域第二虛擬機、來源端虛擬機以及目標端虛擬機的封包轉發模式進行單播/多播模式轉換，VIM控制器對相同網域第一虛擬機、相同網域第二虛擬機、來源端虛擬機以及目標端虛擬機的封包執行動態搬遷。 A SDN-based mechanism for virtual machine live migration system and method, the method includes VIM controller receives a live migration request instruction, obtaining a virtual machine network resource usage information of a first virtual machine in the same network domain, a second virtual machine in the same network domain, a source virtual machine and a target virtual machine from the first and second hypervisors and sent to SDN controller according to the live migration request command, the SDN controller controls the first SDN vSwitch, the second SDN vSwitch, and at least one physical switch to convert the packet forwarding mode of the first virtual machine in the same network domain, the second virtual machine in the same network domain, the source virtual machine, and the target virtual machine to unicast/multicast mode. The VIM controller performs live migration of the packets of the first virtual machine in the same network domain, the second virtual machine in the same network domain, the source virtual machine, and the target virtual machine.

title: NETWORK MANAGEMENT METHOD AND NETWORK ENTITY
abstract: 本發明提供一種網路管理方法及網路實體。在方法中，取得偵測結果。依據偵測結果切換多個網路切片中的一者至另一者。偵測結果為偵測影像的結果。每一網路切片提供網路資源。網路資源用於取得影像。藉此，可動態調整網路設定參數，進而節能。 A network management method and a network entity are provided. In the method, a detection result is obtained. One of the multiple network slices is switched into another according to the detection result. The detection result is the result of detecting an image. Each network slice provides network resources. The network resource is used for obtaining the image. Accordingly, the network setting parameter could be modified dynamically, so as to reduce energy.

title: ACCESS HANDLING WHEN STOPPING 5GSM CONGESTION TIMERS
abstract: 在5G系統中，單網路切片選擇輔助資訊型後退計時器（T3585）可以基於5G系統會話管理擁塞重嘗試指示符應用到第三代合作夥伴計畫存取、非第三代合作夥伴計畫存取或兩者。當使用者裝置透過特定存取接收5G會話管理訊息時，使用者裝置需要停止當前正在運作的計時器。本發明提出使用者裝置停止應用於接收到訊息的相同存取的正在運行的計時器，且也停止應用到兩種存取的正在運行的計時器。當使用者裝置開始應用於兩種存取類型的新的計時器時，本發明提出使用者裝置停止應用於與接收到訊息的存取不同的其他存取的正在運行的計時器。 In 5GS, Single–Network Slice Selection Assistance Information (S-NSSAI) based backoff (BO) timers (T3585) can be applied to either 3GPP access or non-3GPP access or both access based on a 5GSM congestion re-attempt indicator. When UE receives a 5GSM message over a specific access, UE needs to handle a current running timer. In one novel aspect, it is proposed that the UE stops the running timer applied for the same access which the message is received, and also stops the running timer applied for both access types. In another novel aspect, it is proposed that the UE stops the running timer applied for the access different from the access which the message is received when the UE starts a new timer applied for both access types.

title: CROSS-SIM CALLING USING NETWORK SLICE WITH QOS
abstract: 一種使用者設備(UE) (102)藉由經由與一第二蜂巢式網路(104-2)之一無線連接(116)在該UE與一第一蜂巢式網路(104-1)之間建立一網路隧道(122)來採用跨用戶識別模組(跨SIM)傳呼。與該第二蜂巢式網路之該無線連接被用作該UE與該第二蜂巢式網路之間的一網路切片(118)之部分，該網路切片(118)具有適於針對該UE進行一傳呼之一或多個服務品質(QoS)能力。因此，對該UE與該第二蜂巢式網路之間的鏈路之QoS支援促成該UE與該第一蜂巢式網路之間的傳呼之一整體QoS層級。 A user equipment (UE) (102) employs cross-subscriber identity module (cross-SIM) calling by establishing a network tunnel (122) between the UE and a first cellular network (104-1) via a wireless connection (116) with a second cellular network (104-2). The wireless connection with the second cellular network is employed as part of a network slice (118) between the UE and the second cellular network that has one or more quality of service (QoS) capabilities suitable for conducting a call for the UE. Thus, the QoS support for the link between the UE and the second cellular network contributes to an overall QoS level for the call between the UE and the first cellular network.

title: NETWORK SLICE SELECTION IN NETWORK SYSTEMS
abstract: 各種實施例大體上係針對網路切片選擇器（NSS）。在一個實施例中，舉例而言，一演進式節點B （eNB）可包括：一處理器電路；及一NSS，該NSS係用於由該處理器電路執行以將一網路切片（NS）分配給一使用者設備（UE）。該NS可包含一或多個虛擬網路功能（VNF）。在一個實施中，一VNF負責處置在與諸如路由器、交換器等硬體網路連接基礎結構相關聯之一或多個虛擬機器（VM）上執行的特定網路功能。個別VNF可組合或連接在一起以提供給UE一完整的網路連接通訊服務。其他實施例亦被描述且主張。 Various embodiments are generally directed to network slice selector (NSS). In one embodiment, for example, an evolved node B (eNB) may include a processor circuit, and an NSS for execution by the processor circuit to allocate a network slice (NS) to a user equipment (UE). The NS may comprise one or more virtual network function(s) (VNF). In one implementation, a VNF takes on the responsibility of handing specific network functions run on one or more virtual machines (VM) associated with hardware networking infrastructures, such as routers, switches, etc. Individual VNFs may be combined or connected together to provide a complete networking communication service for UEs. Other embodiments are described and claimed.

title: MOBILITY BETWEEN AREAS WITH HETEROGENEOUS NETWORK SLICES
abstract: 本揭示案的某些態樣涉及用於對根據新無線電（NR）技術操作的無線通訊系統中的具有異質網路切片的區域之間的行動性進行處理的方法和裝置。可以由UE執行的示例性方法包括：接收網路切片不可用的指示，進入連接管理閒置（CM-IDLE）狀態，以及在進入CM-IDLE狀態之後利用存取和行動性管理功能（AMF）發起註冊程序。 Certain aspects of the present disclosure relate to methods and apparatus for handling mobility between areas with heterogeneous network slices in wireless communications systems operating according to new radio (NR) technologies. An exemplary method that may be performed by a UE includes receiving an indication that a network slice is not available, entering a connection management idle (CM-IDLE) state, and initiating a registration procedure with an access and mobility management function (AMF) subsequent to entering the CM-IDLE state.

title: AUTHENTICATION AND AUTHORIZATION ASSOCIATED WITH LAYER 3 WIRELESS-TRANSMIT/RECEIVE-UNIT-TO-NETWORK
abstract: 中繼無線傳輸/接收單元(WTRU)可以從請求連接性服務(例如連接性對話參數，例如單一網路切片選擇輔助(S-NSSAI)、資料網路名稱(DNN))的遠端WTRU接收直接通訊請求(DCR)。中繼可以基於與連接性對話(如果已經建立)相關聯的指示及/或來自中繼鄰近服務(ProSe)配置的與DN相關聯的指示來確定針對服務的連接性對話經受次級認證及授權(A&A)。基於該確定，中繼可以觸發針對該遠端WTRU的網路控制授權。中繼WTRU可以發送包括未決的次級A&A的直接通訊接受(DCA)訊息、並且配置與該連接(例如PC5鏈路)相關聯的訊務過濾器以丟棄來自遠端WTRU的資料訊務，直到成功完成次級A&A。 A relay wireless transmit/receive unit (WTRU) may receive a direct communication request (DCR) from a remote WTRU requesting connectivity service (e.g., connectivity session parameters such as single-network slice selection assistance (S-NSSAI), data network name (DNN)). The relay may determine that the connectivity session for the service is subject to a secondary authentication and authorization (A&A), based on an indication associated with the connectivity session if already established and/or an indication associated DN from relay proximity service (ProSe) configuration. Based on the determination, the relay may trigger a network-controlled authorization for the remote WTRU. The relay WTRU may send a direct communication accept (DCA) message including a pending secondary A&A, and configure a traffic filter associated with the connection (e.g., a PC5 link) to discard data traffic from the remote WTRU until a successful completion of the secondary A&A.

title: METHODS AND USER EQUIPMENT FOR MOBILE COMMUNICATIONS
abstract: 一種用於行動通訊的方法，包括：由使用者設備從行動通訊網路接收第五代會話管理拒絕訊息，其中所述第五代會話管理拒絕訊息指示並非由於擁塞控制而導致的網路拒絕；將回退計時器與歸屬共用陸地行動網路的單網路切片選擇輔助資訊相關聯；以及阻止所述使用者設備針對與所述回退計時器相關聯的相同歸屬共用陸地行動網路的單網路切片選擇輔助資訊發送第五代會話管理請求訊息。 A method for mobile communications, comprising: receiving a 5G Session Management (5GSM) reject message from a mobile communication network by a User Equipment (UE), wherein the 5GSM reject message indicates a network rejection not due to congestion control; associating a back-off timer with a Home Public Land Mobile Network (HPLMN) Single-Network Slice Selection Assistance Information (S-NSSAI); and preventing the UE from sending a 5GSM request message for the same HPLMN S-NSSAI that is associated with the back-off timer.

title: REPORT OF SESSION S-NSSAI TO DN-AAA SERVER
abstract: 本文中之實施例係關於向資料網路鑑認授權計費(DN-AAA)伺服器報告與協定資料單元工作階段相關聯之單網路切片選擇輔助資訊(S-NSSAI)。在一實施例中，提出一種藉由實施DN-AAA伺服器之一第一網路功能(101)執行之方法(300)。在一實施例中，該方法可包括從一第二網路功能(102)接收(S301、S302)包括用於一PDU工作階段之網路切片相關資訊之一請求訊息之步驟。在一實施例中，該請求訊息可為至少基於該網路切片相關資訊進行鑑認之存取請求訊息。在另一實施例中，該請求訊息可為指示該PDU工作階段已開始之計費請求訊息。憑藉本文中之實施例，該DN-AAA伺服器(101)可知道與該工作階段相關聯之該網路切片資訊以基於該所接收之工作階段S-NSSAI資訊進行鑑認及統計。 The embodiments herein relate to report of the Single Network Slice Selection Assistance Information (S-NSSAI) that is associated with the Protocol Data Unit Session to Data Network Authentication Authorization Accounting (DN-AAA) server. In an embodiment, there proposes a method (300) performed by a first network function (101) implementing DN-AAA server. In an embodiment, the method may comprise the step of receiving (S301, S302), from a second network function (102), a request message comprising network slice related information for a PDU Session. In an embodiment, the request message may be access request message for authentication at least based on the network slice related information. In another embodiment, the request message may be accounting request message indicating that the PDU session has started. With embodiments herein, the DN-AAA server (101) may know the network slice information that is associated with the session for authentication and statistics based on the received Session S-NSSAI information.

title: AMF APPARATUS, TERMINAL, AND METHODS THEREFOR
abstract: AMF裝置(2)從終端裝置(1)接收登錄要求訊息，登錄要求訊息包含第一資訊，顯示有關同時使用網路之切片的限制功能的支援。AMF裝置(2)從UDM裝置(8)接收終端裝置用戶資訊，終端裝置用戶資訊包含第二資訊，第二資訊顯示有關同時使用網路之切片的限制。若接收到第1資訊以及第2資訊，AMF裝置(2) 傳送包含單一網路切片選擇輔助資訊(S-NSSAI)以及第三資訊的登錄認可訊息到終端裝置(1)。第三資訊包含於前述終端裝置用戶資訊中，並顯示關於前述S-NSSAI有關同時使用網路之切片的限制。舉例而言，這可以對於網路之切片的使用貢獻實現適應各種限制的登錄管理的裝置、方法以及程式。 This AMF device (2) receives, from the terminal (1), a registration request message including first information indicating a support of a limitation function pertaining to simultaneous uses of network slices. The AMF device (2) receives, from a UDM device (8), terminal subscriber information including second information indicating limitations pertaining to simultaneous uses of network slices. When receiving the first information and the second information, the AMF device (2) transmits, to the terminal (1), a registration approval message including Single Network Slice Selection Assistance Information (S-NSSAI) and third information. The third information is included in the terminal subscriber information, and indicates limitations pertaining to simultaneous uses of network slices pertaining to the S-NSSAI. This can contribute to the implementation of registration management adapted to various limitations pertaining to, for example, the uses of the network slices.

title: NETWORK SECURITY SYSTEM AND NETWORK SECURITY METHOD BASED ON MULTI-ACCESS EDGE COMPUTING
abstract: 提出一種基於多接取邊緣運算的網路安全系統和網路安全方法。網路安全方法包含：接收來自核心網路的第一封包，並且解開第一封包以取得裝置資訊表；接收來自用戶終端的第二封包，響應於第二封包與裝置資訊表匹配而根據第二封包以從裝置資訊表取得對應於用戶終端的裝置資訊，並且複製第二封包以產生第三封包；根據第三封包以及裝置資訊判斷第三封包是否對應於異常連線行為以產生偵測結果；根據偵測結果更新對應於用戶終端的路由規則；以及由軟體定義網路交換器根據路由規則轉發第二封包。 A network security system and a network security method are provided. The network security method includes: receiving a first packet from a core network and unpacking the first packet to obtain device information table; receiving a second packet from a user terminal, obtaining, in response to the second packet matching the device information table, device information corresponding to the user terminal from the device information table according to the second packet, and copying the second packet to generate a third packet; determining, according to the third packet and the device information, whether the third packet corresponding to an abnormal connection behavior to generate a detection result; updating a routing rule corresponding to the user terminal according to the detection result; and forwarding, by a software-defined (SDN)switch, the second packet according to the routing rule.

title: METHOD FOR SLICE-BASED ACCESS BARRING AND USER EQUIPMENT USING THE SAME
abstract: 本揭露提供一種用於基於切片的存取禁止的方法和用戶設備。方法包含：通過非存取層獲取單播非存取層信令，其中單播非存取層信令包括對應於網路切片的存取類別定義；通過存取層獲取廣播系統資訊，其中廣播系統資訊包括對應於網路切片的本地存取類別定義；通過存取層將本地存取類別定義遞送到非存取層；通過非存取層發起存取嘗試；通過非存取層根據存取類別定義和本地存取類別定義來判定存取嘗試的存取類別；以及通過存取層根據存取類別來對存取嘗試執行存取禁止檢查。 A method for slice-based access barring and a user equipment are provided. The method includes: acquiring, by the non-access stratum, a unicasted non-access stratum signalling, wherein the unicasted non-access stratum signalling comprises an access category definition corresponding to a network slice; acquiring, by the access stratum, broadcasted system information, wherein the broadcasted system information comprises a local access category definition corresponding to the network slice; delivering, by the access stratum, the local access category definition to the non-access stratum; initiating, by the non-access stratum, an access attempt; determining, by the non-access stratum, an access category of the access attempt according to the access category definition and the local access category definition; and performing, by the access stratum, an access barring check for the access attempt according to the access category.

title: HANDLING OF 5GSM CONGESTION TIMERS
abstract: 在 5GS 中，基於 5GSM 擁塞重新嘗試指示符，基於單網路切片選擇輔助資訊 (S-NSSAI) 的退避 (BO) 定時器 (T3584/T3585) 可以應用於註冊的 PLMN 或所有 PLMN。對於特定的PDU會話，應用於註冊PLMN的相應BO定時器和應用於所有PLMN的BO定時器可以同時運行。建議 UE 在以下所有場景中停止應用於所有 PLMN 的 BO 定時器和應用於註冊 PLMN 的 BO 定時器（如果正在運行）： 1) 接收 PDU 會話釋放命令而沒有 BO 定時器，2 ) 接收具有 5GSM 原因 #39 的 PDU 會話釋放命令，3) 接收 PDU 會話修改命令，4) 接收具有 5GSM 擁塞控制 BO 定時器值的 5GSM 訊息，以及 5) 接收 PDU 會話認證命令。 In 5GS, Single–Network Slice Selection Assistance Information (S-NSSAI) based backoff (BO) timers (T3584/T3585) can be applied to either the registered PLMN or all the PLMNs based on a 5GSM congestion re-attempt indicator. For a specific PDU session, the corresponding BO timer applied to the registered PLMN and the BO timer applied to all PLMN can be both running concurrently. It is proposed for a UE to stop both the BO timer applied to all the PLMNs and the BO timer applied to the registered PLMN, if running, in all the following scenarios: 1) Receiving a PDU session release command without a BO timer, 2) Receiving a PDU session release command with 5GSM cause #39, 3) Receiving a PDU session modification command, 4) Receiving a 5GSM message with a 5GSM congestion control BO timer value, and 5) Receiving a PDU session authentication command.

title: HANDLING OF MULTI-ACCESS PDU SESSION UPGRADE
abstract: 提出了一種處理多存取（MA）協定資料單元（PDU）會話升級的方法及相關使用者設備。MA PDU會話一次使用一個3GPP存取網或一個非3GPP存取網，或同時使用一個3GPP存取網和一個非3GPP存取網。如果在每個無線電存取技術（RAT）存取類型的允許NSSAI中包含相應的單個網路切片選擇輔助資訊（S-NSSAI），則可由網路切片為UE提供服務。根據一個新穎的方面，UE在UE發出MA PDU會話的PDU會話建立請求或PDU會話修改請求之前，對與MA PDU會話相關聯的S-NSSAI是否包括在針對3GPP和非3GPP存取類型的允許的NSSAI中進行附加檢查。 A method of handling multi-access (MA) Protocol data unit (PDU) session upgrade is proposed. An MA PDU session uses one 3GPP access network or one non-3GPP access network at a time, or simultaneously one 3GPP access network and one non-3GPP access network. A UE may be served by a network slice if a corresponding Single Network Slice Selection Assistance Information (S-NSSAI) is included in the allowed NSSAI per Radio Access Technology (RAT) access type. In accordance with one novel aspect, a UE performs additional check on whether the S-NSSAI associated with an MA PDU session is included in the allowed NSSAI for both 3GPP and non-3GPP access types before the UE sending out a PDU session establishment request or a PDU session modification request of the MA PDU session.

title: SYSTEM AND APPARATUS FOR PROVIDING NETWORK ASSISTANCE FOR TRAFFIC HANDLING IN DOWNLINK STREAMING
abstract: 提供了用於第五代（5G）系統（5GS）網路中的串流服務的方法、系統和設備。各個實施例可以提供選擇適當的網路切片，以在網路上供應媒體內容和串流服務。可以指示與服務資訊相對應的期望的網路切片特徵。 Methods, systems, and devices are provided for streaming service in a fifth generation (5G) system (5GS) network. Various embodiments may provide for selecting appropriate network slices for provisioning media content and streaming service over the network. Desired network slice features may be indicated that correspond to service information.

title: METHOD AND SERVER FOR ESTABLISHING A PROTECTING OPTICAL CHANNEL CIRCUIT
abstract: 本發明提供一種保護光纖通道電路供裝方法及伺服器。所述方法包括：取得光傳輸網路中的網路切片需求及其對應的傳輸端點設備、保護等級、峰值資訊速率、一承諾資訊率；反應於判定上述傳輸端點設備足以滿足網路切片需求，建立工作光纖通道電路，並啟用工作光纖通道電路的波長保護恢復功能；反應於判定上述傳輸端點設備的剩餘頻寬資源足以建立保護光纖通道電路，建立保護光纖通道電路；將保護光纖通道電路與工作光纖通道電路設定為屬於鏈結聚合群組，並啟用保護光纖通道電路的波長保護恢復功能。 The invention provides a method and a server for establishing a protecting optical channel circuit. The method includes: obtaining a network slice requirement and transmission endpoint devices, a protection level, a peak information rate, and a commit information rate corresponding thereto; in response to determining that the transmission endpoint devices are sufficient for the network slice requirement, establishing a working optical channel circuit, and activating a wavelength protection recovery function of the working optical channel circuit; in response to determining that remaining bandwidth resources of the transmission endpoint devices are sufficient to establish a protecting optical channel circuit, establishing the protecting optical channel circuit; setting the protecting optical channel circuit and the working optical channel circuit to belong to a link aggregation group, and activating the wavelength protection recovery function of the protecting optical channel circuit.

title: METHODS AND APPARATUSES FOR SLICE-SPECIFIC AUTHENTICATION
abstract: 一種用於行動電話網路中的切片認證的方法。WTRU在與網路的存取和移動性管理功能AMF的註冊程序期間，執行該WTRU的主認證，在該註冊程序期間，該WTRU從該AMF接收一訊息，該訊息指示成功註冊並且包括以下至少一者：關於在該註冊程序之後執行的至少一個針對切片存取的網路切片特定認證和授權SSSA程序的指示、該WTRU被允許存取的切片的列表、以及需要SSSA以用於該WTRU存取的切片的列表，並且在成功註冊之後，執行該WTRU的至少一個SSSA，以存取該網路中的第一切片。 A method for slice authentication in a mobile telephone network. A WTRU performs, during a registration procedure with an Access and Mobility management Function, AMF, of a network, primary authentication of the WTRU, during which registration procedure the WTRU receives from the AMF a message indicating successful registration and including at least one of an indication of at least one network slice-specific authentication and authorization for slice access, SSSA, procedure to be executed following the registration procedure, a list of slices for which the WTRU is allowed access, and a list of slices for which SSSA is needed for access by the WTRU, and performs, after successful registration, at least one SSSA of the WTRU for accessing a first slice in the network.

title: METHOD OF WIRLESS COMMUNICATION IN 5G NETWORK AND USER EQUIPMENT
abstract: 提出了一種定義用於5G會話管理操作的注意（AT）命令的方法。在一個示例中，AT命令可以是用於配置PDU會話建立過程的設置命令。為AT命令+ CGDCONT定義了其他5G參數，包括PDU會話ID，單網路切片選擇輔助資訊（S-NSSAI），服務和會話連續性（SSC）模式，接入類型和反射QoS（RQoS）指示，用以配置 PDU會話。在另一示例中，AT命令可以是用於查詢PDU會話和QoS流參數的讀取命令。為AT命令+ CGCONTRDP或+CGSCONTRDP定義了其他5G參數，包括PDU會話ID（PSI），QoS流ID（QFI），S-NASSI，SSC模式，接入類型和RQoS計時器。 A method of defining ATtention (AT) commands for 5G session management operations is proposed. In one example, the AT command can be a set command for configuring a PDU session establishment procedure. Additional 5G parameters including PDU session ID, Single-Network Slice Selection Assistance Information (S-NSSAI), Service and Session Continuity (SSC) mode, access type, and Reflective QoS (RQoS) indication are defined for AT command +CGDCONT to configure the PDU session. In another example, the AT command can be a read command for querying PDU session and QoS flow parameters. Additional 5G parameters including PDU session ID (PSI), QoS flow ID (QFI), S-NASSI, SSC mode, access type, and RQoS timer are defined for AT command +CGCONTRDP or +CGSCONTRDP.

title: MULTIPLE LEVEL SOFTWARE-BASED NETWROK MANAGEMENT SYSTEM AND METHOD THEREOF
abstract: 本發明提出一種多層級軟體式網路管理系統及其方法。此系統包括數台軟體定義網路交換器、數台軟體定義網路控制器及頂層軟體式管理伺服器。各軟體定義網路控制器管理其管轄下的軟體定義網路交換器，以形成區域拓樸。頂層軟體式管理伺服器管控那些軟體定義網路控制器，基於那些軟體定義網路的區域拓樸形成全域拓樸，而此全域拓樸記錄所有區域拓樸的連接路徑。當系統中之網路終端被新增或移除時，會利用全域拓樸進行鏈路偵測與服務路徑計算，找出最短與最佳分流路徑，並將路徑資訊更新至所有服務設備上，提供路徑備援與頻寬擴充之功能。 A multiple level software-based network management system and a method thereof are provided. The system includes multiple SDN switches, multiple SDN controllers and a highest level software-based management server. Each SDN controller manages the belonging SDN switches, to form a local topology. The highest level software-based management server manages the SDN controllers, and forms a full-region topology according to the local topologies, where the full-region topology records connection path of all local topologies. When a network terminal is added or removed from the system, link detection and service path calculation would be performed according to the full-region topology, to find out the shortest and best bypass path and update the path information to all service equipment, so as to provide backup path and bandwidth extension.

title: METHOD FOR MATCHING FLOW TABLES AND SWITCH
abstract: 一種比對流量表的方法及交換器，此比對流量表的方法包含當軟體定義網路中之交換器接收到封包時，交換器解析封包之標頭檔以取得封包所涉及之至少一相關規則欄位，根據至少一相關規則欄位及交換器之複數個流量表的複數個興趣規則欄位，選擇相關流量表，及將封包所涉及之至少一相關規則欄位的內容與相關流量表之至少一流量條目所對應的規則內容相比對。相關流量表之至少一流量條目具有相同之至少一興趣規則欄位，且封包所涉及之至少一相關規則欄位包含相關流量表之至少一興趣規則欄位。 Disclosed are a method for matching a flow table and a switch. The mthod includes a switch of the software defined networking analyzing a header of a package to retrieve at least one related rule column when the switch receives the package, selecting a related flow table according to the at least one related rule column and a plurality of interested rule columns of a plurality of flow tables in the switch, and matching the rule content corresponding to at least one flow entry in the related flow table with the content of the at least one related rule column. The at least one flow entry has the same interested rule column and the at least one related rule column includes the interested rule column of the related flow table.

title: NETWORK SLICE-SPECIFIC ACCESS BARRING FOR WIRELESS NETWORKS
abstract: 一種技巧包括藉由一使用者裝置偵檢與該使用者裝置對接取一無線網路所進行之一接取嘗試相關聯之一網路切片，以及藉由該使用者裝置基於與該接取嘗試相關聯之該網路切片針對該接取嘗試做出一阻擋決策。另一例示性技巧可包括藉由一基地台從一無線網路內之一或多個核心網路實體接收網路切片特定負載資訊，其針對一或多個網路切片中之各者指出一負載，藉由該基地台基於該所接收網路切片特定負載資訊來判定一阻擋組態，其針對一或多個接取類別指出一組阻擋參數，以及藉由該基地台向一使用者裝置發送該阻擋組態，以降低該無線網路上之一負載。 A technique includes detecting, by a user device, a network slice associated with an access attempt by the user device to access a wireless network, and making, by the user device, a barring decision for the access attempt based on the network slice associated with the access attempt. Another example technique may include receiving, by a base station from one or more core network entities within a wireless network, network slice-specific load information that indicates a load for each of one or more network slices, determining, by the base station based on the received network slice-specific load information, a barring configuration that indicates a set of barring parameters for one or more access categories, and sending, by the base station to a user device, the barring configuration to reduce a load on the wireless network.

title: METHOD FOR CONFIGURING A FREQUENCY PRIORITY, TERMINAL DEVICE, BASE STATION, AND CORE NETWORK DEVICE
abstract: 本申請實施例提供了一種配置頻率優先順序的方法、終端設備、基地台和核心網路設備，基地台或核心網路設備在配置頻率優先順序資訊時，考慮終端設備註冊的網路切片所對應的頻率資訊，進而，可以更為有效的配置頻率優先順序資訊。該方法包括：向核心網路設備發送第一請求訊息，該第一請求訊息用於請求終端設備註冊的網路切片資訊；接收該核心網路設備發送的針對該第一請求訊息的回應訊息，該回應訊息包括該終端設備所註冊的網路切片資訊；根據該回應訊息，配置針對該終端設備的頻率優先順序資訊；向該終端設備發送所配置的該頻率優先順序資訊。 The embodiment of the present application provides a method for configuring a frequency priority, a terminal device, a base station, and a core network device, when configuring the frequency priority information, the base station or the core network device considers the frequency information corresponding to the network slice which registered by the terminal device. Further, the frequency priority information can be configured more efficiently. The method includes: sending a first request message to a core network device, where the first request message is used to request the information of network slice registered by the terminal device; and receiving a response message sent by the core network device for the first request message, the response message of the network slice registered by the terminal device is included; the frequency priority information for the terminal device is configured according to the response message; and sent the configured frequency priority information to the terminal device.
company_name: GUANGDONG OPPO MOBILE TELECOMMUNICATIONS CORP., LTD.
assignees: GUANGDONG OPPO MOBILE TELECOMMUNICATIONS CORP., LTD.

title: MOBILITY BETWEEN AREAS WITH HETEROGENEOUS NETWORK SLICES
abstract: 本揭示案的某些態樣涉及用於對根據新無線電（NR）技術操作的無線通訊系統中的具有異質網路切片的區域之間的行動性進行處理的方法和裝置。可以由UE執行的示例性方法包括：接收網路切片不可用的指示，進入連接管理閒置（CM-IDLE）狀態，以及在進入CM-IDLE狀態之後利用存取和行動性管理功能（AMF）發起註冊程序。 Certain aspects of the present disclosure relate to methods and apparatus for handling mobility between areas with heterogeneous network slices in wireless communications systems operating according to new radio (NR) technologies. An exemplary method that may be performed by a UE includes receiving an indication that a network slice is not available, entering a connection management idle (CM-IDLE) state, and initiating a registration procedure with an access and mobility management function (AMF) subsequent to entering the CM-IDLE state.

title: NETWORK SERVICE CONFIGURATION AND SELECTION USING NETWORK SLICES
abstract: 描述了藉由以下方式使用網路切片資訊來協商和選擇網路服務的技術：決定期望的必需的網路提供的功能的集合；辨識用於提供在必需的功能的集合中的功能中的一或多個功能的網路切片的集合；及向網路傳送針對在所辨識的網路切片的集合中每一個切片的切片辨識符。 Techniques are described using network slice information to negotiate and select network services by determining a set of desired required network provided functionalities; identifying a set of network slices providing one or more of the functionalities in the set of required functionalities; and communicating, to a network, a slice identifier for each slice in the set of the identified network slices.

title: NETWORK ACCESS PRIVACY
abstract: 本案內容提供了可以在例如多切片網路中應用的、用於在嘗試存取網路時保持隱私的技術。通常，示例性方法包括：向服務網路發送註冊請求訊息以向服務網路註冊；接收用於指示已經建立了與服務網路的安全連接的第一確認訊息；在接收到第一確認訊息之後，向服務網路發送安全訊息，其中該安全訊息包括對UE想要在其上進行通訊的至少一個配置的網路切片的指示，其中該至少一個配置的網路切片與設置的隱私標記相關聯；及從服務網路接收用於指示允許UE在該至少一個配置的網路切片上進行通訊的第二確認訊息。 The present disclosure provides techniques that may be applied, for example, in a multi-slice network for maintaining privacy when attempting to access the network. An exemplary method generally includes transmitting a registration request message to a serving network to register with the serving network; receiving a first confirmation message indicating a secure connection with the serving network has been established; transmitting, after receiving the first confirmation message, a secure message to the serving network comprising an indication of at least one configured network slice that the UE wants to communicate over, wherein the at least one configured network slice is associated with a privacy flag that is set; and receiving a second confirmation message from the serving network indicating that the UE is permitted to communicate over the at least one configured network slice.

title: PRIORITIZING INCOMPATIBLE NETWORK SLICES
abstract: 本案內容的某些態樣係關於用於對根據新無線電（NR）技術操作的無線通訊系統中的不相容網路切片進行優先化的方法和裝置。可以由UE執行的示例性方法包括以下步驟：發送針對連接到網路切片集合的請求，其中請求包括與網路切片集合中的至少一個網路切片相關聯的至少一個優先順序；及回應於請求，接收對經允許的網路切片集合進行指示的信號傳遞。 Certain aspects of the present disclosure relate to methods and apparatus for prioritizing incompatible network slices in wireless communications systems operating according to new radio (NR) technologies. An exemplary method that may be performed by a UE includes sending a request to connect to a set of network slices, wherein the request comprises at least one priority associated with at least one network slice in the set of network slices, and receiving signaling indicating a set of allowed network slices in response to the request.

title: USER EQUIPMENT REGISTRATION METHOD FOR NETWORK SLICE SELECTION AND NETWORK CONTROLLER AND NETWORK COMMUNICATION SYSTEM USING THE SAME
abstract: 一種用以選擇網路切片的使用者設備註冊方法、網路控制器與網路通訊系統。所述方法包括：接收使用者設備(UE)的註冊請求；響應於接收包括切片選擇資訊的註冊請求，依據切片選擇資訊判斷是否具有服務UE的能力，而傳送包括切片選擇資訊的第一網路功能探索請求或用以尋找目標存取與行動管理功能的第二網路功能探索請求；在接收對應於第一網路功能探索請求的網路功能探索回覆後，依據網路功能探索回覆選擇用以服務UE的網路功能而執行註冊設定操作，或在接收對應於第二網路功能探索請求的另一網路功能探索回覆後，發送介面連結釋放訊息至接取節點。 A user equipment registration method for network slice selection, and a network controller and a network communication are provided. The method includes: receiving a registration request of a UE; in response to receiving the registration including slicing selection information, checking whether capable of serving the UE according to the slicing selection information to transmit a first network function discovery request including the slicing selection information or to transmit a second network function discovery request for searching a target Access and Mobility Management Function (AMF); and selecting a network function for serving the UE according to the network function discovery response to perform a registration setting operation after receiving a network function discovery response corresponding to the first network function discovery request, or transmitting an interface connection release message to an access node after receiving another network function discovery response corresponding to the second network function discovery request.

title: NETWORK SYSTEM WITH SEAMLESS HANDOVER MECHANISM, OPERATION METHOD AND CONTROL APPARATUS THEREOF
abstract: 一種基於軟體定義網路(SDN)下具備無縫換手機制的網路系統與相關的運作方法、控制裝置。網路系統包括多個網路設備、多個主機裝置以及控制裝置。網路設備相互連接，並且部份網路設備提供無線接取網路以供主機裝置連接，這些無線接取網路具有相同的服務集識別碼(SSID)。控制裝置連接至網路設備，其中當主機裝置中的第一主機裝置由網路設備中的第一網路設備改為連接至第二網路設備時，控制裝置對應於第一主機裝置所發出的位址解析要求封包，控制網路設備以回傳位址解析回覆封包至第一主機裝置，藉以維持第一主機裝置的網際網路協定(IP)位址。 A network system based on software define network (SDN) with seamless handover mechanism, an operation method and a control apparatus thereof are provided. The network system includes a plurality of network apparatuses, a plurality of host apparatuses and a control apparatus. The network apparatuses are connected together, part of the network apparatuses are equipped with wireless access networks of the same Service Set Identifier (SSID), and each of the host apparatus is respectively connected to one of the network apparatuses. The control apparatus is connected to the network apparatuses. When a first host apparatus of the host apparatus is changed to connect a second network apparatus from a first network apparatus, in response to an address resolution request packet transmitted from the first host apparatus, the control apparatus controls the network apparatuses to return an address resolution response packet to the first host apparatus, so as to maintain an Internet Protocol (IP) address of the first host apparatus.

title: NETWORK COMMUNICATION PROTOCOL TRANSLATION SYSTEM AND METHOD
abstract: 一種網路通訊協定轉譯系統及方法。軟體定義網路控制器自軟體定義網路交換器接收第一封包。第一封包記載來源裝置之來源通訊協定之名稱及目的地裝置之目的地通訊協定之名稱，其中來源通訊協定及目的地通訊協定不同。軟體定義網路控制器將第一封包轉發至跨協定代理伺服器。跨協定代理伺服器將符合來源通訊協定之第一封包轉譯為符合目的地通訊協定之第二封包，再傳送第二封包至目的地裝置。跨協定代理伺服器自目的地裝置接收第三封包，將符合目的地通訊協定之第三封包轉譯成符合來源通訊協定之第四封包，再傳送第四封包至來源裝置。 A network communication protocol translation system and method are provided. The SDN controller receives a first packet from the SDN switch. The first packet records the name of the source protocol of the source apparatus and the name of the destination protocol of the destination apparatus. The source protocol and the destination protocol are different. The SDN controller forwards the first packet to the cross proxy. The cross proxy translate the first packet that conforms to the source protocol to the second packet that conforms to the destination protocol and transmits the second packet to the destination apparatus. The cross proxy receives the third packet from the destination apparatus, translates the third packet that conforms to the destination protocol to the fourth packet that conforms to the source protocol, and transmits the fourth packet to the source apparatus.

title: METHOD, TERMINAL EQUIPMENT, AND NETWORK EQUIPMENT FOR WIRELESS COMMUNICATION
abstract: 一種無線通訊的方法、網路設備和終端設備，該方法包括︰第一設備接收第二設備發送的網路切片資訊，該網路切片資訊用於指示多個網路切片；該第一設備根據該網路切片資訊，從該多個網路切片中確定目標網路切片，該目標網路切片包括該第一設備支援的至少一個網路切片；該第一設備根據該目標網路切片，進行無線通訊。本發明實施例的方法、網路設備和終端設備，透過瞭解對端的網路切片資訊，能夠瞭解對端發送的多個網路切片的情況，從而能夠更好地選擇目標網路切片進行無線通訊，進而提高無線通訊的品質。 Disclosed in embodiments of the present invention are a wireless communication method, a network device, and a terminal device. The method comprises: a first device receives network slice information sent by a second device, the network slice information being used for indicating multiple network slices; the first device determines a target network slice among the multiple network slices, the target network slice comprising at least one network slice supported by the first device; and the first device performs wireless communication according to the target network slice. In the wireless communication method, the network device and the terminal device in the embodiments of the present invention, by learning about network slice information of a peer end, the condition of multiple network slices sent by the peer end can be learnt about; and accordingly, a target network slice can be better selected to perform wireless communication, so as to improve the quality of the wireless communication.

title: Fiber optic switch
abstract: 本發明係提供一種光纖光交換機，利用光纖的交換功能的接法，結合光信號放大器、分光器與分波多工與合光器，軟體定義網路(SDN,Software Define Network)開放訊務(Open-flow)的管控單元，達成多光輸入輸出埠，瞬時交換之光線路連接通信。本發明的彈性架構，從基本型光交換機，可提升至多速率多波道光交換機。達成多波道獨立切換。因此可以充分使用單模光纖頻寬。應用光交換設備開放訊務控管技術，達成光信號信令流(Control plan)與訊務流(Data Plan)智能化處理訊務。 The present invention provides a fiber optic switch using an connection method having optical fiber switching function, and in combination with an optical signal amplifier, a splitter, and a Wavelength Division Multiplexing (WDM) device, and a coupler, and a SDN (Software Define Network) open-flow control unit to achieve optical circuit connection communication with multiple light input/output ports and instantaneous exchange. The flexible architecture of the present invention can be upgraded from a basic optical switch to a multi-rate multi-channel optical switch to achieve multi-channel independent switching. Therefore, the bandwidth of single-mode fiber can be fully used. The open-flow control technology of an optical switching equipment is used to achieve intelligent processing open-flow of the optical signal control plan and data plan.
